All 13 tests now pass. The bug was in `textkit/slugify.py`:

- `_SEPARATORS` did not include `-`, so existing dashes were not collapsed (`"Hello -- World"` became `hello----world`).
- `_INVALID` allowed only `-` as a separator, so a custom separator such as `_` was deleted.
- Leading and trailing separators were never stripped, and truncating to `max_length` could leave a trailing separator.

The fix removes invalid characters first, then collapses any run of whitespace, `_` or `-` into `sep` and strips it from both ends. After truncation it strips a trailing `sep`. No tests were changed.
